description: Defines the NetworkQuality class and related enums for caching and managing network quality metrics such as RTT and throughput.

classes.name: NetworkQuality
classes.description: A class to cache and compare network quality metrics such as RTT and throughput.

methods.name: NetworkQuality
methods.description: Constructor initializing network quality metrics with specific RTT and throughput values.

methods.name: IsFaster
methods.description: Compares if this network quality is at least as fast as another.

methods.name: http_rtt
methods.description: Returns the HTTP layer RTT estimate.

methods.name: set_http_rtt
methods.description: Sets the HTTP layer RTT estimate.

methods.name: transport_rtt
methods.description: Returns the transport layer RTT estimate.

methods.name: set_transport_rtt
methods.description: Sets the transport layer RTT estimate.

methods.name: downstream_throughput_kbps
methods.description: Returns the downstream throughput in Kbps.

methods.name: set_downstream_throughput_kbps
methods.description: Sets the downstream throughput in Kbps.

methods.name: VerifyValueCorrectness
methods.description: Verifies that network quality values are within expected ranges.
